SELECT m.id, m.send_user_id, fu.avatar as headPortrait, fu.sex as gender, fu.nick_name as nickName, m.create_time, m.article_id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.img, '$[0]')) as articleImg, m.comment_id, ac.content as commentContent, ac.anonymous, m.type, case when acc.content is not null then acc.content else a.content end as content, m.status, a.type as articleType, CASE WHEN (SELECT count(1) FROM user_to_like ut WHERE ut.del_flag = 0 AND ut.praise_type = 'COMMENT' AND ut.target_id = m.comment_id AND ut.user_id = #{userId}) = 0 then false else true end as isLike FROM message m left join article a on m.article_id = a.id left join article_comment ac on m.comment_id = ac.id left join article_comment acc on ac.comment_id = acc.id LEFT JOIN t_user fu ON m.send_user_id = fu.id
m.del_flag = 0 and m.user_id = #{userId}
and m.type in ('1','2')
and m.type in ('3','4')
order by m.create_time desc, m.id desc
